headline: Tech Mahindra and Cisco Partner to Bring AI-Driven Security Service Edge to Global Enterprises
summary: Tech Mahindra (NSE: TECHM), a leading global provider of technology consulting and digital solutions to enterprises across industries, announced a partnership with Cisco to deliver an AI-driven Security Service Edge (SSE) offering for global enterprises. The joint offering will help enterprises reduce security complexity, improve visibility and control, deliver seamless user access, and strengthen resilience as they scale cloud, hybrid work, and AI adoption.

headline: Jeetu Patel, Cisco President: Fortt Knox Innovation Lab
summary: At AMD's Advancing AI event, Cisco product chief Jeetu Patel argues inferencing is shifting from spiky chatbots to always-on agents, driving "deskside" devices that run hundreds of agents beside your laptop. He casts Cisco as the common security/management plane across cloud, private, and local AI, backs open source (new 350M/1B vuln-finding models), and says cheaper tokens boost demand via Jevons Paradox — optimize cost-per-outcome, not per-token.
